name: autofurigana
description: Adds furigana above Japanese kanji on web pages. Works fully offline with no data collection or internet requests.

scripts.test:browser: npm run test:chromium && npm run test:firefox
scripts.test:release: npm test && npm run package && npm run test:browser
scripts.package:firefox: node build/build.js firefox && node build/pack.js firefox
scripts.package:chrome: node build/build.js chrome && node build/pack.js chrome
